title: Define the canonical decision-leg roster codec
description: Independent P1.4 prerequisite. Add a pure bounded codec and digest for the exact ordered legs a decision claims, including expected leg identity and nullable per-leg receipt binding for no-business-effect outcomes. Provide the stable decision-ledger integrity refusal surface without changing persistence or readers yet.
definitionOfDone: The codec accepts 1..MAX_DECISION_LEGS ordered entries with contiguous zero-based indexes, unique aggregate identifiers, safe expected versions, deterministic canonical receipt identifiers, and either an all-present receipt request/effect digest pair or an all-null pair.

Canonical encode/decode and SHA-256 identification bind roster version, ordered count, every leg identifier/fence, and every nullable receipt digest; frozen valid one-leg and three-leg rosters round-trip byte-identically.

Missing, extra, reordered, substituted, duplicate, sparse, malformed digest, mixed-null, and prototype/accessor hostile inputs refuse with code STORE_CORRUPT at layer DECISION_LEDGER and never return a partial roster.
Focused store tests run standalone with nonzero counts and mutating order/count or omitting either receipt digest makes named assertions red.
taskRails: Do not edit store contracts, schema, writer, reader, or existing tests in this slice.
Use MAX_DECISION_LEGS and the existing bounded identifier/integer validation conventions; do not infer expected entries from receipt rows.
The no-business-effect form binds expected leg identity/fence with null receipt digests; it does not claim a receipt that was never committed.
